what: Focus follows the task across a SplitPage swap, a retry, an aside close and a palette or More-sheet jump; the route screens name themselves; the small P3s of shell cycle 2 go.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/shell/page-aside.tsx, the page detail host (focus return only)
packages/basalt-ui/src/shell/** (focus after a palette or More-sheet navigation)
change:
Fixes by finding:
- shell-2.2: when `selected` flips below `wide`, `SplitPage` moves focus to the pane it shows: the detail's heading or first focusable on select, the list's current item on back.
- shell-2.3: the error template hands focus to main after its retry re-renders the route.
- shell-2.4: closing the aside returns focus to the latest opener.
- shell-2.5: a palette or More-sheet navigation hands focus to main through the path a navigating page action uses.
- shell-2.7: the missing and error templates wrap their `EmptyState` in `Page` with a `PageBar` title.
- shell-2.8: the playground's `main.tsx` installs the three init screens once.
- shell-2.9: a `filterSlot` holding a single enum filter draws it inline, and a single-value choice closes the filter dialog.
- shell-2.10: the `StatGroup` strip lays out two stats per row in a narrow container.
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui, one per finding group (split focus, aside focus, navigation focus, templates, filter, stat strip); the playground main.tsx change in its own commit.
proof: make check; 390 px layout tests for both SplitPage directions; a test that opens two rows and closes the aside; a 390 px shot of the stat strip.
acceptance: At 390 px, selecting in a SplitPage list and taking its back link both leave focus inside the shown pane (layout test)
Closing the aside after a second row retitled it returns focus to the second row (test)
A palette jump and a More-sheet jump leave focus in main (layout test)
The scaffolded not-found and error screens render one h1
A lone enum filter changes in at most two interactions, and the dialog closes after a single choice
The phone StatGroup strip shows two stats per row
out_of_scope: The crumb parent and the phone crumb rule (v3-shell-2-crumb).
